audit.why: Level chart (Skill/Vel'Koz x5/Skill) matches winCon and breakdown.difficulty text describing Vel'Koz owning levels 2-6 via poke and combo, both layers agree.

spikes[] correctly cite level 2 (Q+W double-cast), level 6 (R execute vs Bard's stasis R), 1st item (Liandry's/Blackfire plasma burst), and late (teamfight flank punish) — all four power spikes are grounded in the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vel'Koz's E (Tectonic Disruption) is a knockup + short displacement per Riot's text ("knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away"), not a root. whys[2], mid, and wants.foe[1] all call it a 'root'. Also 'mid' claims E slows, but the slow belongs to Q (Plasma Fission), not E — E carries no slow flag.
audit.why: Calling a knockup a root misdescribes the CC type a player needs to plan around (knockup cannot be walked out of pre-cast the way some roots can, and it combos differently with Bard's own CC-cancel options like R stasis), and attributing the slow to the wrong ability sends the reader looking for a slow on E that isn't there.
audit.corrected: Changed 'root' to 'knockup' in whys[2] and wants.foe[1]; changed 'E slow-then-knockup' to 'E knockup plus Q slow' in mid.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 belong to Vel'Koz: with E slow-then-knockup plus Q and W he has a full root-into-burst combo that your Meep poke can't trade back into. Ward the flanks, use Magical Journey to disengage rather than face-tank, and never walk up in a straight line where his Q-E lands cleanly.

Ward the flanks, use Magical Journey to disengage rather than face-tank, and never walk up in a straight line where his Q-E lands cleanly.
